stations.title: Dougie
stations.say: How often did paging run tonight?
stations.note: After a busy night at the base.

stations.title: The handlers
stations.text: Twenty handlers, none counts or times itself

stations.title: Your decorators
stations.gap: No lines that wrap a handler

captions: After a busy night, Dougie wants to know how often each handler ran and how long it took.
Today twenty handlers run with nothing around them, and nobody can say.
You write decorators once and put them on any handler with a single line.
Now every page is counted and every call is timed, and each handler works as before.
Dougie reads the whole night from the report, without opening one handler.
